findings_and_questions.kind: Existing 774 rig F049 and 059 q641 conditional candidate, independently reconnected at95e; native P16 support021 corroborates arithmetic; no new count
findings_and_questions.observation: Public Millimeters(u16) and derived-Deserialize BreastplateDesign admit structurally arbitrary raw wall values. After profile validation, outer validate_breastplate calls Anime validation before checking the 1–20 mm wall bound; Anime evaluates gauge.0 * 2 after its earlier checks. An otherwise-valid profile/Anime design with gauge32768 reaches u16 overflow before the outer bound. In checked arithmetic this is a panic path; with wrapping at that value the outer bound subsequently rejects.
findings_and_questions.qualification: This is source and arithmetic reasoning, no request, fixture, build, test or observed panic. Other gauge values and compiler overflow-check settings can lead to different first errors; do not claim malformed geometry accepted, valid gauge rejected by this overflow case, or all callers invoke this path. Selected JSON loader and DeviceBreastplate call validator; no native device call was run. q608 is related pending evidence, not an automatic additional finding.
findings_and_questions.future_repair_direction: After audit and explicit implementation authorization, establish bounded gauge and total cross-field validation at the canonical owner before arithmetic, preserving legitimate values and meaningful structured errors.

thirteen_lenses.producer-propagation: Raw authoring design -> explicit checked validation -> selected codec or device; warmup independently mutates construction after cloning and can violate an already-valid cross-field relation.
thirteen_lenses.existing-type-owners: Millimeters and Permille carry units but expose u16 backing and do not independently impose breastplate gauge bounds; reuse a checked owner only after its exact semantics are established.
thirteen_lenses.admission-contracts: Bracer codec checks inputs both before encode and after decode; breastplate hash/device selected path validates. Derived serde remains a raw authoring boundary and is not itself validated admission.
thirteen_lenses.invariant-operations: Anime gauge doubling occurs before parent gauge bound; short-circuited fluting fade and ordering protect its u16 operations. Distinguish overflow checks, wrapping and later rejection.
thirteen_lenses.aggregate-states: Construction-specific lap lift depends on gauge; independently valid values and a successful Solid validation do not certify the later alternate Anime combination.
thirteen_lenses.type-ownership: The native authoring/validator owner determines accepted recipes; GPU/device and renderer handle later generation, and typed hashes alone do not certify anatomy or semantic catalog membership.
thirteen_lenses.redundant-authority: GENERATOR_VERSION and SCHEMA_VERSION are distinct stated version signals; no claim of equivalent runtime behavior or duplicate authority. Parent/inner validator ordering is a dependency, not automatic duplicate validation.
thirteen_lenses.behavior-preservation: Preserve Solid and Anime modes, None fluting, admitted zero profile controls, legitimate >1000 scale factors, widened bracer placement sum and intended diagnostic categories.
thirteen_lenses.enum-shapes: BreastplateConstruction owns its Anime payload; optional fluting deliberately distinguishes no decoration. No forced flag or unconditional conversion is justified by names.
thirteen_lenses.derivability: Derived Deserialize reflects raw DTO semantics and deny_unknown_fields, not hidden validation; manual encode/decode gates have real policy. No blanket derive or blanket ban on raw records.
thirteen_lenses.granularity: Separate serialized authoring state, validated recipe, selected construction, generated device artifact, visual acceptance and raw byte digest; one does not establish another.
thirteen_lenses.magic-strings: catalog_id is a potentially semantic raw identity with q2689 still open; typed errors and fixed log/native text are different boundaries. No unproved prose classifier or namespace rule.
thirteen_lenses.magic-numbers: Per-field bounded integer ranges and version numbers have distinct meanings; Permille is a scaling unit, not universally a probability. Recorded constants do not by themselves justify replacing every literal.

limits: Static source and offline evidence verification only. No armor, GPU, shader, renderer, fixture or product execution; no builds, tests, probes, repairs or publication edits.
